title: A combined in silico and in vitro new approach methodology for early detection of liver steatogenic chemicals.
authors: Verhoeven, Anouk; Gadaleta, Domenico; Isbaita, Nisreen H K; Jiang, Jian; Sanz-Serrano, Julen; Serrano-Candelas, Eva; Ortega-Vallbona, Rita; Vanhaecke, Tamara; Vinken, Mathieu
one_liner_zh: 该文用(Q)SAR、read-across和对接预测配体激活转录因子，结合体外肝细胞实验评估化学物致脂肪肝，虽涉及TF-DNA相关转录因子但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，属边缘相关。
abstract: Fatty liver disease is the most prevalent hepatic pathology, with accumulating evidence suggesting that chemical exposure may contribute to its development and progression. Consequently, mechanistic understanding of perturbations leading to liver steatosis is essential for chemical safety assessment. This study introduces a new approach methodology (NAM), mechanistically anchored in an adverse outcome pathway network, which integrates in silico and in vitro approaches to enable early detection of steatogenic chemicals upon repeated dose exposure. For this purpose, 7 reference steatogenic chemicals, including 3 pharmaceuticals (sodium valproate, tetracycline hydrochloride and amiodarone hydrochloride), a pesticide (cyproconazole), and 3 plasticizers (tricresyl phosphate, perfluorohexanesulfonic acid and perfluorooctanoic acid) as well as 2 non-steatogenic chemicals (minocycline hydrochloride and tartaric acid) were evaluated at 3 concentrations to induce molecular initiating events and key events related to liver steatosis. Modulations in ligand-activated transcription factors were assessed using an in silico tiered workflow combining (Q)SAR, read-across and docking. Human HepaRG liver cells were subsequently used to quantify transcriptional and functional changes in downstream key events, including lipid accumulation, fatty acid uptake, mitochondrial beta-oxidation, lipid secretion, mitochondrial dysfunction, endoplasmic reticulum stress and oxidative stress. A steatogenic score was calculated for each chemical by integrating the biological relevance and the magnitude of responses across all assessed endpoints. These scores clearly distinguished steatogenic from non-steatogenic chemicals. Overall, the current study shows the potential of the NAM to identify the steatogenic properties of chemicals during early stages of hazard assessment.
abstract_zh: 脂肪肝病是最常见的肝脏病理状态，越来越多的证据表明化学物质暴露可能促进其发生和发展。因此，理解导致肝脏脂肪变性的扰动机制对于化学物质安全评估至关重要。本研究引入了一种新的方法学（NAM），其机制锚定于不良结局通路网络，整合了计算机模拟和体外方法，以实现重复剂量暴露下致脂肪变性化学物质的早期检测。为此，评估了7种参考致脂肪变性化学物质，包括3种药物（丙戊酸钠、盐酸四环素和盐酸胺碘酮）、1种农药（环丙唑醇）和3种增塑剂（三甲苯磷酸酯、全氟己烷磺酸和全氟辛酸），以及2种非致脂肪变性化学物质（盐酸米诺环素和酒石酸），在3个浓度下诱导与肝脏脂肪变性相关的分子起始事件和关键事件。使用结合（Q）SAR、交叉参照和分子对接的计算机模拟分层工作流程评估配体激活转录因子的调节。随后使用人HepaRG肝细胞量化下游关键事件中的转录和功能变化，包括脂质积累、脂肪酸摄取、线粒体β-氧化、脂质分泌、线粒体功能障碍、内质网应激和氧化应激。通过整合所有评估终点中的生物学相关性和响应幅度，为每种化学物质计算了致脂肪变性评分。这些评分清晰地区分了致脂肪变性化学物质与非致脂肪变性化学物质。总体而言，本研究展示了该NAM在危害评估早期阶段识别化学物质致脂肪变性特性的潜力。
